Gently slide the floss between teeth and under the gumline.

title: Satin Tape Dental Floss - Mint

details.description: This Dental Floss is made from the highest quality floss to deliver the most effective dental cleaning. With its comfortable design, you can quickly floss in between all the teeth. Regular flossing with mint floss helps you to remove plaque from between your teeth and along your gum line, where your toothbrush does not reach. It is great for building good dental hygiene habits from a very young age.
